coaching.loss.Fire: Includes smoke, soot, protein fires. If water was used to extinguish, add Water as secondary.
coaching.loss.Water: Verify coverage for groundwater, flood, and sump pump failure — these are often excluded or capped.
coaching.loss.Mold: Usually has coverage limits. Mold from covered water damage is typically covered in full under water coverage.
coaching.loss.Dust/Debris: From construction or remediation (flood cuts, charred material). Common secondary contaminant.
coaching.loss.Puffback: Furnace/fireplace malfunction pushes soot or oily residue into the home. No flames.
coaching.loss.Oil: Heating oil spill/mist. Requires dry cleaning only — washing won't work. May need to replace non-dry-cleanable items.
coaching.loss.Unknown: Cause of loss is not yet determined. No sub-type options — update once identified.
coaching.loss.Other: Windstorms, fallen trees, etc. — perils that don't fit other categories.
coaching.loss.Non-Restoration: Not an insurance claim — regular residential or commercial cleaning unrelated to a loss event.
coaching.role.Policyholder: The person(s) named on the policy who is required to sign our authorization paperwork.
coaching.role.Primary: The primary contact handling our portion of the project. May or may not be the policyholder or owner — can be a PA, employee, or family member.
coaching.role.Referral: The first person that called us with the order. When assigned, we have the go-ahead to begin. Note: some referrers may only be giving us a lead.
coaching.role.ExpertStainRemoval: A per-hour charge for removing complicated loss-related stains from items worth saving.
coaching.role.FindAddress: Use Google to insert a valid, verified address.
coaching.group.LTFD: Long Term Final Delivery (greater than 1 month)
coaching.group.TLI: Total Loss Inventory of non-salvageable items
coaching.group.Test: Test cleaning to determine scope (results needed ASAP)
coaching.group.Dispose: Items that will not be returned
coaching.group.Storage Only: Items that will be stored and returned without cleaning
coaching.service.Appliance: Large items requiring specialized handling (refrigerators, ranges, etc.).
coaching.service.TLI: Total Loss Inventory - listing/valuing non-restorable items.
coaching.section.interview: Ask the customer these questions during or before the initial visit.
coaching.section.timeline: Plan pickups, rush deliveries, in-home events, and final delivery based on the repair schedule and living situation.
coaching.section.eventInstructions: What scheduling and field team need to know — conditions, access, customer preferences, what to bring.
coaching.section.repairs: Repair type determines your delivery timeline and potential blockers. Each option auto-suggests a delivery group and adds delivery instructions.
coaching.section.rush: Rush deliveries get essentials (clothing, bedding, toiletries) to the customer within days. The delivery address will auto-link to their first living situation.
coaching.section.planner: Select delivery groups and assign dates/addresses. One group must be the Final (F) delivery — this determines storage duration.
coaching.section.finalWarning: One group should be marked as Final (F) — this determines storage duration.
coaching.section.stayingHome: Customer is staying in the home. Deliveries will be made to the primary address. Consider a Rush Final Delivery (RFD) if everything can be rushed.
coaching.section.addHome: Add "Their Home" as the last step to mark return after repairs.
coaching.section.events: Any travel or formal events during the repair period? We'll make sure the right items are pulled and delivered on time.
coaching.section.groups: Select the delivery groups that apply. These feed into the Rush Guide timeline.
coaching.field.orderName: Auto-generated from LastName-TownST. Lock to prevent changes.
coaching.field.lossType: Pick the primary peril — what happened first. Example: kitchen fire put out with water = Fire primary, Water secondary.
coaching.field.contaminants: e.g. Fire with water damage from firefighting, or water loss leading to mold. Incompatible types are grayed out.
coaching.field.severity: Typically entered after the site inspection, not during intake.
coaching.field.rejectScale: Severity reject scale: 1 = None, 2 = Possible, 3 = Many expected, 5 = Extreme.
coaching.field.contaminantLevels: Rate specific contaminant levels. 0 = None, 3 = Severe. Typically completed after the site inspection — not during intake.
coaching.field.qualityCode: Customer's quality standard. Q1 = Highest (designer/luxury items), Q5 = Basic (everyday items).
coaching.field.handlingCodes: Special processing instructions. Hover each code for its meaning.
coaching.field.referrer: The referrer reached out with this order. If assigned, we can begin. If only a lead, we cannot contact the customer yet.
coaching.field.isLead: A Lead requires selling the customer and getting approvals from the adjuster before we proceed. No billable charges yet — just an opportunity we will pursue.
coaching.field.isOrder: An Order is a confirmed project ready to be scheduled and worked.
coaching.step.1: Select the building type and access details for the property.
coaching.step.2: Set the property size — floors, bedrooms, and square footage.
coaching.step.3: Confirm rooms and mark affected areas.
coaching.step.4: Set severity, handling codes, and instructions per room.
